title: CompTIA Security+ SY0-801 Study Guide: Exam-Focused V8 Reference with AI Threats, Exam Tra
description: Walk into the SY0-801 exam having already sat it the hard way. Security+ is the certification that moves you from general IT into security work. The new SY0-801 exam does not reward memorized definitions. It hands you a scenario, four options that all sound right, and a clock. This study guide teaches every objective, then makes you prove it twice: on the page, and on a timed exam built like the real one. What you will learn General Security Concepts: security controls, the CIA triad, zero trust, change management and cryptography, and how they drive real decisions. Threats, Vulnerabilities, and Attacks: threat actors, vectors, indicators of malicious activity, and the new AI objective: prompt injection, poisoning, model manipulation and jailbreaking. Security Architecture: cloud, on-premises and hybrid models, protecting data, resilience and recovery. Security Operations: hardening, vulnerability management, monitoring, identity and access, automation and incident response. The largest domain on the exam, and the longest part of the book. Security Program Management and Oversight: governance, risk, third parties, compliance, audits and security awareness. Inside the book 27 chapters, one for every SY0-801 objective. 216 scenario questions where every answer choice is explained: why the right one wins and why each wrong one loses. Answers start on a new page, so you commit before you check. Exam Trap boxes flag the confusions the exam is built on, a What Changed table maps SY0-701 to SY0-801, and the back of the book gives you acronyms, ports and protocols, an objective-to-page map and an index.
